info.description: Data model containing model dependencies of the clients of the current microservice (WebApp, ServiceTest)

ID.description: A UUID identifying a resource, nested object, catalogue definition, option or assignment in a declared ownership and type scope.

constraints: A display name or assigned external identity value is not this UUID.
Null means absent where permitted by the provider; an empty UUID does not identify a resource.

x-osdc-semantic.referenceDefinition: Cant is measured in the orthogonal tool body frame about the along-hole z axis; the declared positive convention applies for tool inclination less than or equal to 90 degrees.

constraints: Permitted values are +1 and -1.
This is an interval extent, not a depth coordinate.

X.description: WGS84 Riemannian north coordinate in SI metres: signed meridian arc from the equator, north positive. X and RiemannianNorth are aliases; this is not an arbitrary projected northing.

Y.description: WGS84 Riemannian east coordinate in SI metres: signed arc along the latitude parallel from Greenwich, east positive. Y and RiemannianEast are aliases; this is not an arbitrary projected easting.

Z.description: True vertical depth (TVD) in SI metres, positive downward relative to the WGS84 ellipsoid in persisted Trajectory survey data. Z and TVD are aliases; this is not measured depth or an elevation.

RiemannianNorth.description: WGS84 Riemannian north coordinate in SI metres: signed meridian arc from the equator, north positive. X and RiemannianNorth are aliases; this is not an arbitrary projected northing.

RiemannianEast.description: WGS84 Riemannian east coordinate in SI metres: signed arc along the latitude parallel from Greenwich, east positive. Y and RiemannianEast are aliases; this is not an arbitrary projected easting.

TVD.description: True vertical depth (TVD) in SI metres, positive downward relative to the WGS84 ellipsoid in persisted Trajectory survey data. Z and TVD are aliases; this is not measured depth or an elevation.

Abscissa.description: Measured depth (MD), the curvilinear coordinate along this trajectory/survey run, in SI metres from its declared MD origin. MD and Abscissa are aliases. This is not true vertical depth; a vertical datum offset alone does not change an MD origin.

MD.description: Measured depth (MD), the curvilinear coordinate along this trajectory/survey run, in SI metres from its declared MD origin. MD and Abscissa are aliases. This is not true vertical depth; a vertical datum offset alone does not change an MD origin.

FormatVersion.description: Version 1 lossless matrix. Missing Values denotes unavailable legacy matrix entries.

Values.description: Nine row-major entries. Covariance uses square metres in north/east/depth axes; eigenvector entries are dimensionless. Legacy dimension-only payloads remain readable.

ConfidenceFactor.description: Dimensionless confidence proportion greater than 0 and no greater than 0.999.

AlertThreshold.description: Dimensionless separation-factor Alert threshold; it must be greater than AlarmThreshold.

AgeThreshold.description: Comparison trajectory age threshold in canonical SI seconds, evaluated from the oldest defined contributing survey-run acquisition start or station measurement time.

OrientationAngle.description: Radians clockwise from true north toward east for the horizontal ellipse major axis. An axis is unoriented, modulo pi.

x-osdc-semantic.referenceDefinition: Zero is local true/geodetic north; angles increase clockwise toward east about the downward local normal. Canonical azimuth is in [0, 2*pi) radians; magnetic north and grid north are different references.

x-osdc-semantic.referenceDefinition: Zero along-hole depth is the intersection of the oriented wellbore path, or its defined extension, with the WGS84 ellipsoid. The coordinate is signed accumulated arc length from that intersection along the declared path orientation. It is not obtained by adding or subtracting a vertical elevation offset.
referenceRequiredContext: selected intersection when multiple intersections exist

SurveyAzimuthReference.description: North reference for an observed clockwise azimuth. TrueNorth is WGS84 geodetic north projected onto the plane perpendicular to the selected vertical; MagneticNorth is the evaluated geomagnetic-field vector projected onto that plane; InheritRun uses the survey run default.

SurveyGeomagneticModel.description: Geomagnetic model used for magnetic-north correction: Automatic selects WMM2025 for 2025 or later and IGRF14 for earlier instants; an explicit value pins that model.

SurveyInclinationReference.description: Reference vertical for an observed inclination. GeodeticVertical is the local positive-down axis perpendicular to the WGS84 ellipsoid (opposite its outward normal); GravityVertical follows the local total-gravity vector; InheritRun uses the survey run default.

MeasurementID.description: Stable UUID for this measurement, independent of list position.

Origin.description: Measured for an instrument observation; Extrapolated only for the final caller-supplied bit station in LastStationAlreadyExtrapolated mode.

MD.description: Measured or along-hole depth in canonical SI metres.

Inclination.description: Canonical inclination from the local WGS84 geodetic-down axis in SI radians, after reference correction.

Azimuth.description: Canonical clockwise azimuth from WGS84 geodetic true north in SI radians, after reference correction.

ObservedInclination.description: Original observed inclination in SI radians before transformation from InclinationReference.

ObservedAzimuth.description: Original observed clockwise azimuth in SI radians before transformation from AzimuthReference.

MeasurementTimeUtc.description: UTC measurement instant. Required for magnetic correction when the survey run has no complete acquisition interval.

InclinationReference.description: Reference vertical for an observed inclination. GeodeticVertical is the local positive-down axis perpendicular to the WGS84 ellipsoid (opposite its outward normal); GravityVertical follows the local total-gravity vector; InheritRun uses the survey run default.

AzimuthReference.description: North reference for an observed clockwise azimuth. TrueNorth is WGS84 geodetic north projected onto the plane perpendicular to the selected vertical; MagneticNorth is the evaluated geomagnetic-field vector projected onto that plane; InheritRun uses the survey run default.

Correction.description: Frozen correction result and Earth-model provenance used to derive canonical inclination and azimuth.

AppliedInclinationCorrection.description: Signed canonical-minus-observed inclination correction in SI radians.

AppliedAzimuthCorrection.description: Shortest signed canonical-minus-observed azimuth correction in SI radians.

MagneticDeclination.description: Evaluated magnetic declination clockwise from geodetic true north in SI radians.

GravityNorth.description: North component of total gravity in the local WGS84 north-east-down frame, in SI metres per second squared.

GravityEast.description: East component of total gravity in the local WGS84 north-east-down frame, in SI metres per second squared.

GravityDown.description: Down component of total gravity in the local WGS84 north-east-down frame, in SI metres per second squared.

EvaluatedLatitude.description: WGS84 geodetic latitude used for the correction, in SI radians.

EvaluatedLongitude.description: WGS84 geodetic longitude used for the correction, in SI radians.

EvaluatedDepthWgs84.description: Depth used for the correction in SI metres, positive downward from the WGS84 reference ellipsoid.

EvaluationTimeUtc.description: UTC instant used to evaluate the geomagnetic model.

TimeMethod.description: How EvaluationTimeUtc was selected: station measurement time, survey-run acquisition midpoint, or not required.

AlgorithmVersion.description: Opaque version of the reference-correction algorithm.

AcquisitionStartUtc.description: Earliest known survey-run acquisition instant in UTC; required together with AcquisitionEndUtc when station times are absent for magnetic correction.

AcquisitionEndUtc.description: Latest known survey-run acquisition instant in UTC; required together with AcquisitionStartUtc when station times are absent for magnetic correction.

DefaultInclinationReference.description: Reference vertical for an observed inclination. GeodeticVertical is the local positive-down axis perpendicular to the WGS84 ellipsoid (opposite its outward normal); GravityVertical follows the local total-gravity vector; InheritRun uses the survey run default. InheritRun is forbidden for a run-level default.

DefaultAzimuthReference.description: North reference for an observed clockwise azimuth. TrueNorth is WGS84 geodetic north projected onto the plane perpendicular to the selected vertical; MagneticNorth is the evaluated geomagnetic-field vector projected onto that plane; InheritRun uses the survey run default. InheritRun is forbidden for a run-level default.

GeomagneticModel.description: Geomagnetic model selection used by measurements whose effective azimuth reference is MagneticNorth.

BitExtrapolation.description: Optional terminal extrapolation from the final measurement-tool station to the bit. When present, exactly one terminal calculated or caller-identified extrapolated station is included in the calculated SurveyStationList.

Mode.description: CalculateFromLastMeasurement derives a terminal station on the server; LastStationAlreadyExtrapolated requires exactly the final submitted row to have Origin Extrapolated.

MeasurementToolToBitDistance.description: Distance-to-bit elevation of the measurement tool relative to the bit front face, positive upward in canonical SI metres; used as the positive along-hole MD increment to the bit.

OrientationAngle.description: Radians in the fixed vertical-section ellipse axis convention: major-axis direction (-sin(phi),cos(phi)) in (section distance, positive-down TVD). An axis is unoriented, modulo pi. This is not an azimuth relative to north or the wellbore tangent.

x-osdc-semantic.referenceDefinition: In the plane with coordinates section distance and positive-down TVD, angle phi specifies the unoriented major-axis direction (-sin(phi), cos(phi)). Zero is the downward TVD axis; positive rotation is toward negative section distance. Directions separated by pi describe the same ellipse axis.
